metadata.description: Ignite_Final: ARM creates memberships and, for Ex4, usage plan/enrollment. Run New-ServiceGroupExtensions.ps1 AFTER the ARM runner succeeds to create SG-scoped goals, recovery plans and drills.

Name of the already-existing Service Group (created by step1) to assign a resilience goal to. Default matches step1's default naming formula so both templates chain together in the same resource group with no parameters.
Name of the Standard Usage Plan (RG + subscription scoped).
Name of the enrollment child resource binding the Service Group to the Usage Plan.

apiVersion for usagePlans/enrollments/recoveryPlans. A Usage Plan + Enrollment must exist before a recoveryPlans resource can be created against the Service Group (RHBLUserErrorNotEnrolled otherwise).

Name of the Azure Health Model created by step1. Default matches step1's naming formula. Used to build the Health Model's own resourceId referenced by the Drill's healthModelMonitoringProperties.healthModelId.

Resource ID read from step1's 'vnetId' output and passed in by the deploy script, so the Service Group membership relationship below can be created here in step2 - well after step1's Service Group creation, avoiding the serviceGroups/read RBAC-propagation race seen when membership relationships were created in the same deployment as the Service Group itself.
